hooks.name: Security Scan
hooks.description: Review security-sensitive file changes against 01-tenancy-rules, 03-auth-modes, 16-identity-boundaries, 11-soc2. Report findings by severity.

action.prompt: Review the change against 01-tenancy-rules, 03-auth-modes, 16-identity-boundaries, 11-soc2. Report findings by severity CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW with exact locations and fixes. Do not auto-fix; propose.
